objectives.text: Filter rows with WHERE using comparison operators, AND, OR, IN, BETWEEN and LIKE
Sort results with ORDER BY on one or more columns, ascending or descending
Page results with LIMIT and OFFSET, and explain why LIMIT without ORDER BY returns an unpredictable subset
